title: The installed Frequency app's status bar matches the cool canvas and the strip behind the phone's system buttons is black

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14, installed the app on Android: artifacts from the old DAWN system on top and bottom; black out the bottom control area; clean it up.

detail: Frequency's browser-chrome pair (theme-color meta, the pre-paint bootstrap and the PWA manifest's theme_color and background_color, written from SITE_DESIGN at build) still carried the old sand canvas #FAF4EA and the Thermal ink. It is now the cooled Commons canvas #F4F6F7 (SCAN-907) and the Stage blue-black #070B14, so the status bar and splash match the live palette. In the installed app (display-mode standalone) on an edge-to-edge phone, a fixed band the height of the bottom safe area paints the darkest void behind the system navigation, under the floating tab bar. The app icons still carry a light cream ground; redrawing them is outside this row. An installed app picks up manifest colours after it is reopened or reinstalled.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=fs.readFileSync('lib/theme/design.ts','utf8');const m=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8');const bad=[];const i=d.indexOf(\"id: 'frequency'\");const f=i<0?'':d.slice(i,i+600);if(f.includes('FAF4EA'))bad.push('the Frequency chrome is still the old sand');if(!f.includes('F4F6F7'))bad.push('the Frequency chrome is not the cooled canvas');if(!/display-mode: standalone[\s\S]*body::after[^}]*safe-area-inset-bottom/.test(m))bad.push('no black band behind the system navigation in the installed app');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-916: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
